description: Two channels of filter and amplifier whose gain and brightness are driven from the EXCITE input by an envelope, a vactrol model, an envelope follower or a compressor

params.text: Sets the attack and decay character of that channel's function: the envelope times, the slowness of the vactrol, or the reaction time of the follower
Sets how far the filter opens and closes with the gain; past noon the modulation shrinks again and an offset replaces it, so the filter is shut fully counter-clockwise and open fully clockwise
Attenuates that channel's LEVEL input; with nothing patched there it works as a gain offset
Sets that channel's amplifier response, exponential at one end and linear at the other
One press shows that channel's function on the display, and each further press steps through envelope, vactrol, follower and compressor; holding the button switches to the second set of functions
One press brings the bargraph back to the display, and each further press steps the meter between excite, level, input and output

inputs.text: The control signal for that channel: the trigger for the envelope, the signal a vactrol or follower responds to, or the side-chain for the compressor
The audio for that channel; with nothing patched it reads a constant 5V, so the output carries the control signal itself
Drives that channel's amplifier directly through the LEVEL MOD attenuator; with nothing patched it reads 8V

outputs.text: That channel after the filter and amplifier

notes: the number of channels on whichever of the two audio inputs carries more sets how many voices the module runs, up to sixteen, and both outputs carry that many.
menu: Link channels — makes the second channel follow the first channel's settings
Channel 1 mode — Envelope, Vactrol, Follower, Compressor, AR envelope, Plucked vactrol, Cutoff controller, Slow compressor, Direct VCF controller or Lorenz generator for the first channel
Channel 2 mode — Envelope, Vactrol, Follower, Compressor, AR envelope, Plucked vactrol, Cutoff controller, Slow compressor, Direct VCF controller or Lorenz generator for the second channel
Meter — picks what the bargraph shows: Excite, Level, In or Out
